title: CWB Gaming — Game Top-Up Marketplace
tagline: A multi-vendor marketplace for UC, Diamonds, CP and gift codes — pay first, delivered in minutes
description: The buyer side of CWB Gaming, a Bangladesh marketplace for PUBG Mobile UC, Free Fire and Mobile Legends Diamonds, Call of Duty CP, Google Play and Steam codes. Every seller's offer for a pack sits on one comparison page, cheapest first, with rating and delivery speed; the player ID is checked and repeated back before you pay; and nothing is delivered until the payment is confirmed server-side. Payments here go through the marketplace's own sandbox gateway — press Approve and watch the code appear. This is the marketplace's real code running in the browser, sharing its data with the admin and seller demos.
highlights: One page per pack (e.g. PUBG 660 UC) comparing every seller's price, rating and delivery speed
Player ID checked against the game's format and echoed back before payment
Sandbox gateway: Approve sends the signed server-side confirmation — only then is the code shown
Decline it instead and nothing is delivered
Direct top-ups go to the seller's queue with a 30-minute timer — see them in the seller demo
Invoice PDF (INV-CWB-…), disputes and seller reviews from the order page
Phone check at checkout: the SMS code appears on screen in the demo
Buyer sign-in: 01700000001 / demo12345 (past codes stay visible) — ?demo-reset starts fresh
